hero.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a single premium editorial illustration for the business AI learning community NII / FIELD website hero. Wide 4:3 composition, target asset 1200x900. A bold contemporary cut-paper and screen-print collage: one oversized human hand confidently arranges a few work documents, a small spreadsheet, an email envelope and a finished report into an orderly three-step process. The transformation from tangled work to a clear useful result should be immediately legible without words. A small curious turquoise square with two simple white eyes is a subtle mascot companion (not a robot). Large flat shapes, art-directed off-register print details, fine ink lines, clean whitespace between objects. Palette: saturated turquoise #25CDBD, cobalt #3B82F6, coral #E8734A, a few yellow #F5C842 details, dark navy ink #0B1220, white paper. Editorial magazine / designer cultural festival feeling appropriate for intelligent entrepreneurs. Slight tactile paper grain only within shapes. NO 3D, NO clay render, NO glass, NO glossy gradient ribbon, NO floating rounded app cards, NO generic neural network, NO text, NO letters, NO logos, NO watermark. Keep all objects fully within canvas, modest margins; transparent background so illustration can sit on a warm white webpage. This is a newly drawn artwork, not a UI screenshot.
